question:
Who was the founder of the Maurya Empire?
मौर्य साम्राज्य के संस्थापक कौन थे?
explanation: Chandragupta Maurya established the Maurya Empire with the help of Chanakya.

question:
Kalinga war was fought in which year?
कलिंग युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
explanation: Ashoka fought the Kalinga war in 261 BCE and later adopted Buddhism.

question:
Which text is associated with the teachings of Chanakya?
कौन सा ग्रंथ चाणक्य की शिक्षाओं से संबंधित है?
explanation: Chanakya wrote Arthashastra, a treatise on statecraft, economic policy, and military strategy.

question:
Who was the most famous ruler of the Gupta dynasty?
गुप्त वंश का सबसे प्रसिद्ध शासक कौन था?
explanation: Samudragupta was known as the Napoleon of India for his military conquests.

question:
What was the capital of Magadh empire?
मगध साम्राज्य की राजधानी क्या थी?
explanation: Pataliputra (modern Patna) was the capital of Magadh empire.

question:
Who was the founder of the Gupta Empire?
गुप्त साम्राज्य के संस्थापक कौन थे?
explanation: Chandragupta I founded the Gupta Empire in 320 CE.

question:
Who introduced Buddhism to Sri Lanka?
श्रीलंका में बौद्ध धर्म किसने पहुँचाया?
explanation: Mahinda, son of Ashoka, introduced Buddhism to Sri Lanka.

question:
Which king embraced Jainism at the end of his life?
किस राजा ने अपने जीवन के अंत में जैन धर्म को अपनाया?
explanation: Chandragupta Maurya embraced Jainism and went to Karnataka.

question:
The Nalanda University was established during whose reign?
नालंदा विश्वविद्यालय किसके शासनकाल में स्थापित हुआ था?
explanation: Nalanda University was established by Kumaragupta I in the 5th century CE.

question:
Which language was used in Ashoka's inscriptions?
अशोक के शिलालेखों में कौन सी भाषा प्रयुक्त हुई थी?
explanation: Ashoka's inscriptions were primarily written in Prakrit using Brahmi script.
